# telnyx_external_connection_location_update (Action)

Sets the static emergency address of a location of an external connection.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `location_id` (String) The location id.
- `static_emergency_address_id` (String) A new static emergency address ID to update the location with
